decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the clothing picture (m2); Literal keeps "weapons".

decisions.choice: deraya / vazi la vita
decisions.reason: "Silaha" means weapons only. With "put on" the picture is armor (m2), so Balanced says "deraya" (armor) and Readable "vazi la vita" (battle clothing). Literal keeps "silaha".

decisions.choice: qui appartiennent à la nuit (R); les ténèbres (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Les ténèbres" is a literary word; Readable says "la nuit", which keeps the picture of the previous sentence.

decisions.choice: "무기" (L); "갑옷" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word covers weapons and armor (meaning decision). At 6:13 the body's parts are used as "무기"; here the verb is "put on", so Balanced and Readable say "갑옷", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "khí giới" (L), as in 6:13; "áo giáp" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word covers armor and weapons (m2). Literal keeps "khí giới", the word for it in 6:13; Balanced and Readable say "áo giáp" (armor), which fits the picture of putting it on.

source.text: ὡς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ εὐσχημόνως περιπατήσωμεν, μὴ κώμοις καὶ μέθαις, μὴ κοίταις καὶ ἀσελγείαις, μὴ ἔριδι καὶ ζήλῳ, ἀλλὰ ἐνδύσασθε τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, καὶ τῆς σαρκὸς πρόνοιαν μὴ ποιεῖσθε εἰς ἐπιθυμίας.

records.literal_gloss: As in day properly let us walk, not in revelries and drunkenness, not in beds and sensuality, not in strife and jealousy, \v 14 but put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and of the flesh provision not make for desires.

en.L: Let us walk properly, as in [the] day, not in revelries and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and debauchery, not in strife and jealousy; \v 14 but put on the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, and make no provision for the flesh, for [its] desires.
en.B: Let us live decently, as people do in the daytime: not in wild parties and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and shameless excess, not in quarrels and envy. \v 14 Instead, put on the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} like clothing, and do not make plans to satisfy the desires of the flesh.
en.R: We should live in a way that is right for the daytime, when everyone can see. We should not go to wild parties or get drunk. We should not have sex outside of marriage or do shameful things. We should not fight or be jealous. \v 14 Instead, let the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} be like the clothes you wear. Do not keep thinking about how to give your sinful self what it wants.

es.L: Como en [el] día, andemos decentemente, no en orgías y borracheras, no en promiscuidad y desenfreno, no en contiendas y envidia, \v 14 sino {{plural_you:vístanse|vestíos}} del Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, y no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} provisión para la carne, para [sus] deseos.
es.B: Comportémonos con decencia, como la gente se comporta de día: no en fiestas desenfrenadas y borracheras, no en inmoralidad sexual y excesos desvergonzados, no en peleas y envidias. \v 14 Al contrario, {{plural_you:vístanse|vestíos}} del Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} como quien se pone la ropa, y no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} planes para satisfacer los deseos de la carne.
es.R: Debemos vivir de un modo que convenga al día, cuando todos pueden ver. No vayamos a fiestas desenfrenadas ni nos emborrachemos. No tengamos relaciones sexuales fuera del matrimonio ni hagamos cosas vergonzosas. No peleemos ni tengamos envidia. \v 14 Al contrario, que el Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} sea como la ropa que {{plural_you:llevan|lleváis}} puesta. No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} pensando en cómo darle a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} yo pecador lo que quiere.

sw.L: Kama katika mchana, na tutembee kwa heshima, si katika sherehe za anasa na ulevi, si katika uasherati na ufisadi, si katika ugomvi na wivu, \v 14 bali jivikeni Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, wala msiandae mpango kwa ajili ya mwili, kwa [ajili ya] tamaa [zake].
sw.B: Tuishi kwa adabu, kama watu waishivyo mchana: si katika sherehe za anasa na ulevi, si katika uasherati na tabia za aibu zisizo na kiasi, si katika ugomvi na wivu. \v 14 Badala yake, jivikeni Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kama vazi, wala msifanye mipango ya kutimiza tamaa za asili ya dhambi.
sw.R: Tunapaswa kuishi kwa namna inayofaa mchana, wakati kila mtu anaweza kuona. Tusiende kwenye sherehe za anasa wala kulewa. Tusifanye mapenzi nje ya ndoa wala kufanya mambo ya aibu. Tusigombane wala kuoneana wivu. \v 14 Badala yake, Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} awe kama nguo mnazovaa. Msiendelee kufikiria jinsi ya kuipa asili yenu ya dhambi kile inachotaka.

fr.L: Comme de jour, marchons avec dignité, non dans les orgies et les beuveries, non dans la promiscuité et la débauche, non dans la querelle et la jalousie, \v 14 mais revêtez le Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et ne prenez pas soin de la chair pour [ses] désirs.
fr.B: Conduisons-nous avec dignité, comme on le fait en plein jour : pas d’orgies ni d’ivrognerie, pas de débauche sexuelle ni d’excès sans pudeur, pas de querelles ni de jalousie. \v 14 Revêtez plutôt le Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} comme un vêtement, et ne faites pas de projets pour satisfaire les désirs de la chair.
fr.R: Nous devons vivre comme il convient en plein jour, quand tout le monde peut voir. N’allons pas à des fêtes déchaînées et ne nous enivrons pas. N’ayons pas de relations sexuelles en dehors du mariage et ne faisons pas de choses honteuses. Ne nous disputons pas et ne soyons pas jaloux. \v 14 Au contraire, que le Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} soit comme les vêtements que vous portez. Ne cherchez pas sans cesse comment donner à votre moi pécheur ce qu’il réclame.

ko.L: 낮에 [걷는] 것처럼 단정하게 걸읍시다. 흥청거리는 잔치와 술 취함으로 [걷지] 말고, 음란과 방탕으로 [걷지] 말고, 다툼과 시기로 [걷지] 말고, \v 14 오히려 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}로 옷 입으십시오. 그리고 욕망을 위하여 육신을 위한 계획을 세우지 마십시오.
ko.B: 낮에 사는 사람답게 단정하게 삽시다. 흥청망청한 잔치와 술 취함, 음란과 방탕, 다툼과 시기 속에 살지 맙시다. \v 14 오히려 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 옷처럼 입으십시오. 그리고 육신의 욕망을 채울 궁리를 하지 마십시오.
ko.R: 모든 사람이 볼 수 있는 낮에 사는 것처럼 바르게 삽시다. 흥청거리는 잔치에 가거나 술에 취하지 맙시다. 결혼 밖에서 성관계를 하거나 부끄러운 짓을 하지 맙시다. 싸우거나 질투하지 맙시다. \v 14 오히려 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분이 입는 옷이 되시게 하십시오. 죄에 끌리는 본성이 원하는 것을 어떻게 채워 줄까 하는 생각을 계속하지 마십시오.

vi.L: Chúng ta hãy bước đi cách đứng đắn, như giữa ban ngày, không trong những cuộc truy hoan và say sưa, không trong dâm loạn và phóng đãng, không trong tranh cãi và ganh ghét; \v 14 nhưng hãy mặc lấy Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, và đừng chăm lo cho xác thịt để [thỏa mãn] các dục vọng.
vi.B: Chúng ta hãy sống cách đứng đắn như người ta sống giữa ban ngày: không chè chén say sưa, không dâm loạn trác táng, không tranh cãi ganh ghét. \v 14 Trái lại, hãy mặc lấy Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} như mặc áo, và đừng lo tính để thỏa mãn những dục vọng của xác thịt.
vi.R: Chúng ta nên sống cách đúng đắn như người ta sống giữa ban ngày, khi mọi người đều có thể thấy. Chúng ta đừng dự những cuộc tiệc tùng trác táng hay say rượu. Chúng ta đừng quan hệ tình dục ngoài hôn nhân hay làm những điều đáng hổ thẹn. Chúng ta đừng gây gổ hay ganh ghét nhau. \v 14 Trái lại, hãy để Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} như chiếc áo anh chị em mặc. Đừng cứ nghĩ cách chiều theo những gì bản tính tội lỗi của mình muốn.

pt.L: Andemos com decência, como de dia, não em orgias e bebedeiras, não em imoralidade sexual e libertinagem, não em contenda e ciúme; \v 14 mas vistam-se do Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, e não façam provisão para a carne, para [os seus] desejos.
pt.B: Vivamos com decência, como se vive durante o dia: não em farras e bebedeiras, não em imoralidade sexual e excessos sem pudor, não em brigas e inveja. \v 14 Pelo contrário, vistam-se do Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} como de uma roupa, e não façam planos para satisfazer os desejos da carne.
pt.R: Devemos viver do jeito certo para o dia, quando todos podem ver. Não devemos ir a festas desregradas nem ficar bêbados. Não devemos ter relações sexuais fora do casamento nem fazer coisas vergonhosas. Não devemos brigar nem ter inveja. \v 14 Pelo contrário, deixem que o Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} seja como a roupa que vocês vestem. Não fiquem pensando em como dar à natureza pecadora de vocês o que ela deseja.

am.L: በቀን እንደምንሆን በአግባቡ እንመላለስ፤ በፈንጠዝያና በስካር አይሁን፤ በዝሙትና በሴሰኝነት አይሁን፤ በጠብና በቅናት አይሁን፤ \v 14 ነገር ግን ጌታ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} ልበሱ፤ ለሥጋም ለምኞቱ የሚሆን ዝግጅት አታድርጉ።
am.B: በቀን እንደሚኖሩ ሰዎች በጨዋነት እንኑር፤ በፈንጠዝያና በስካር አንኑር፤ በዝሙትና በሴሰኝነት አንኑር፤ በጠብና በቅናትም አንኑር። \v 14 ይልቁንም ጌታ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} እንደ ልብስ ልበሱት፤ የሥጋንም ምኞት ለማርካት አታቅዱ።
am.R: ሰው ሁሉ በሚያይበት በቀን እንደሚገባ እንኑር። ወደ ፈንጠዝያ ግብዣ አንሂድ፤ አንስከርም። ከጋብቻ ውጭ የፆታ ግንኙነት አናድርግ፤ አሳፋሪ ነገርም አንሥራ። አንጣላ፤ አንቅና። \v 14 ይልቁንም ጌታ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እንደምትለብሱት ልብስ ይሁንላችሁ። ኃጢአተኛው ማንነታችሁ የሚፈልገውን እንዴት እንደምትሰጡት ሁልጊዜ አታስቡ።

decisions.choice: three pairs of night-time sins
decisions.reason: κώμοις were drunken parties and night processions through the streets; κοίταις is literally "beds", sexual immorality; ἀσελγείαις is shameless indecency that no longer cares who sees. The last pair, strife and jealousy, shows that quarrels belong to the darkness as much as drunkenness.

decisions.choice: live as in the daytime
alternatives: live as people who belong to the coming day
decisions.reason: περιπατήσωμεν ("walk") is the usual biblical word for how a person lives. "As in the day" means behaving as people do in daylight, where nothing is hidden; it also fits Paul's picture of the coming day (verse 12), so both may be meant.

decisions.choice: put on the Lord Jesus Christ: take on his life and character as one's own
decisions.reason: The clothing picture of verse 12 now has a person as the clothing. In Galatians 3:27 believers "have put on Christ" when baptized; here those who already belong to him are told to live out that union day by day.

decisions.choice: the sinful self opposed to God
decisions.reason: σαρκὸς here is human life turned against God, with desires of its own, as in Galatians 5:16-17. Paul does not mean the body as such.

decisions.choice: provision: planning ahead
decisions.reason: πρόνοιαν is forethought: Paul forbids thinking ahead about how to satisfy those desires.

decisions.choice: your sinful self
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means here (m4), as in Galatians 5.

decisions.choice: have sex outside of marriage or do shameful things
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for what the two Greek words describe (m1).

decisions.choice: when everyone can see
decisions.reason: Readable explains what living as in the daytime means (m2).

decisions.choice: like clothing / be like the clothes you wear
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the clothing picture clear (m3), since "put on" a person is not ordinary English.

decisions.choice: asili ya dhambi
decisions.reason: "Mwili" is the body, and "tamaa za mwili" would sound like bodily appetites only. Here the word means the sinful self opposed to God (m4), so Balanced and Readable say "asili ya dhambi" (sinful nature). Literal keeps "mwili".

decisions.choice: la chair (L, B); votre moi pécheur (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and Hebrews, "la chair" is kept at Literal and Balanced so the reader can follow Paul's word for the self turned away from God (meaning decision); Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "걷다" (L); "살다" (B, R) for walk, as at 8:4
decisions.reason: Walking is the Greek picture for how one lives; the letter's fixed rendering for each level.

decisions.choice: "주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}로 옷 입다" (L); "... 를 옷처럼 입다" (B); "... 께서 여러분이 입는 옷이 되시게 하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Putting on the Lord Jesus Christ means taking on his life and character as one's own (meaning decision). Korean keeps the picture of clothing at every level; Balanced and Readable mark it as a picture.

decisions.choice: "육신" (L, B); "죄에 끌리는 본성" (R), as settled at 7:5
decisions.reason: The flesh here is the sinful self opposed to God (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "bước đi" (L); "sống" (B, R), as in 6:4
decisions.reason: "Walk" is a way of saying how one lives; Literal keeps the picture, Balanced and Readable say "sống", as settled at 6:4.

decisions.choice: "xác thịt" (L, B); "bản tính tội lỗi" (R), as in 7:5
decisions.reason: The flesh here is the sinful self opposed to God (m4), the sense of chapters 7-8, so the words of 7:5 are used.

decisions.choice: "truy hoan và say sưa", "dâm loạn và phóng đãng" (L); "chè chén say sưa", "dâm loạn trác táng" (B)
decisions.reason: Three pairs of night-time sins (m1). Balanced joins each pair into one four-word Vietnamese phrase, which is how Vietnamese lists vices; Readable says each in plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a natureza pecadora de vocês
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means here (m4), as the English "your sinful self"; "natureza pecadora" is the ordinary Brazilian church phrase, and "eu pecador" sounds forced in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}}, with the case ending inside each option
alternatives: "ክርስቶስ" with the ending outside the span
decisions.reason: Where the two options take the same ending, the ending may stand outside the span; here the object ending is written in each option so both read as whole words. For the rest of these chapters: "መሲሕ" where the Greek has no article, "መሲሑ" (the Messiah) where it has one, and "የመሲሑ" for "of Christ".

decisions.choice: "ሥጋ" (L, B); "ኃጢአተኛው ማንነታችሁ" (your sinful self, R)
decisions.reason: "ሥጋ" is the church's word for the flesh and is kept at Literal and Balanced. At Readable it would be heard only as the body or as meat, so the sense, the self that sets itself against God, is said plainly; "ማንነት" (who one is) is closer to the English Readable "your sinful self" than "ተፈጥሮ".
